items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: You know, Mario Minelli? ... He know Mario Minelli. You know him, eh? Oh yeah.

ctx.x: Say you can hear Peter Bocars? Oh yeah, Peter, yeah. Peter and I used to play with Peter. Peter and his brother, he knew his brother, eh? Charlie. I don't believe he played no more tonight. You know, Mario Minelli?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My teacher. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he used to play with me too... He teaches yet over the river.

ctx.x: He know Mario Minelli. You know him, eh? Oh yeah.
Yeah, he used to play with me too, but he was with Kitty Harris. He used to play a violin player too. Violet, slider, sax and chord it, bass, piano, and all that. He teaches yet over the river.
